title: FIFA World Cup 2026 official tournament page
claim: Official FIFA tournament hub for the 2026 World Cup teams, groups, schedule, venues, and tournament context. This is the primary source for validating the 48-team field before forecasting.

title: 2026 FIFA World Cup cross-check page
claim: Cross-check page for the 2026 World Cup format, expanded 48-team field, groups, teams, and tournament dates. Use as a secondary sanity check, not as the primary source.

title: FIFA/Coca-Cola World Rankings
claim: Official FIFA ranking source that can be refreshed and used as one team-strength input. The bundled demo does not claim to contain a live ranking feed.

title: ClubElo API
claim: ClubElo documents CSV API endpoints for daily club rankings and club histories; this can be used as a player-pool proxy if licensing and methodology are acceptable.

title: Forecast VAR source registry
claim: Local registry describing which sources are bundled, refreshable, placeholders, manual or paid adapters, and disabled by default.

title: Bundled sample team priors
claim: Illustrative offline feature table with team strength rating, rank proxy, recent form proxy, travel/load proxy, host advantage, and source ids for all 48 teams. Replace before public forecasting.

title: Forecast VAR demo rating model
claim: Educational model converting strength priors into match, group, and tournament probabilities. It produces model-derived probabilities, uncertainty warnings, and scenario outputs, not certainties.

title: API-Football adapter slot
claim: Optional live data source for fixtures, injuries, lineups, events, odds, and standings when API access and terms permit. It is not called by default in this offline episode.

title: football-data.org adapter slot
claim: Optional structured-data source for competitions, teams, squads, matches, and standings. World Cup coverage depends on access plan and date.

title: TheSportsDB fallback adapter slot
claim: Fallback sports-data adapter for events, lineups, and timelines; useful for cross-checking but not the primary forecast source.

title: StatsBomb Open Data historical World Cup adapter slot
claim: Historical World Cup event data can help calibrate upset, draw, and scoreline priors; it is not a live 2026 team-strength source.

title: Curated evidence notes
claim: Manual evidence notes capture high-signal context such as injury, suspension, tactical, motivation, and policy notes. Every note should be timestamped and reviewed.

title: Bundled sample market odds
claim: Illustrative 1X2 odds snapshot used to demonstrate de-vig market-implied probabilities and model-vs-market comparison. It is demo data and not betting advice.

title: Generated evidence index
claim: Local evidence index built from source cards, curated notes, sample team features, and sample market odds. It powers transparent lightweight RAG for the forecast agent.

title: Forecast VAR Monte Carlo simulator
claim: Educational Monte Carlo tournament simulator that estimates group advancement and champion probabilities from match probabilities and locked rolling results. It is approximate and not official prediction advice.
